versions.changelog: Security: permissions manifest (Lp3/MCP Least Privilege), --dry-run + --yes interlocks on all state-changing commands (resolve/mute/activate/token management)
MCP-compatible config (.rollbar-mcp.json), --project-name option, project-tokens/create/update commands, --save flag to auto-persist tokens
MCP-compatible config (.rollbar-mcp.json), --project-name option, project-tokens/create/update commands, --save flag to auto-persist tokens
v1.3.0: per-agent token isolation — reads from $PWD/secrets/rollbar or $PWD/.env (ROLLBAR_ACCESS_TOKEN); falls back to env var. ROLLBAR_ACCESS_TOKEN no longer a hard requirement.
Security: fix shell injection in ITEM_ID/PROJECT_ID args, fix Python code injection in LIMIT/HOURS params. All inputs now validated and passed via env vars.
Declare required env vars and binaries (curl, python3) in metadata. Add security guidance for token storage. Recommend project-scoped tokens as default.
Initial release: list/inspect/resolve/mute errors, multi-project support via account tokens, deploy tracking, top errors ranking
